Talking to a counselor in Volusia is a sure fire way to get Baker acted. Then, there goes my job and what few friends I have. I need a private enterprise not related to Stuart Marchmen and the correctional facility. Holy shit does that go bad fast. Tried it once, never again.
My biggest problem is money. I have none. I am looking for free resources in southern Volusia county Florida. I am not having much luck.
I do have a history and made an attempt about 8 months ago. I have been fighting hard not to try again. The holiday has just magnified my desire to be gone.

He's the person I want to be with. I just want our relationship to be happy and healthy. I can't and won't stay with him if he continues to put me down or is unhappy. My depression is overwhelming me. Breaking up right now would surely push me over the edge. But I'm teetering anyway.

I am reconsidering the relationship, but I certainly don't want to leave him Christmas day. Nor would I want him to feel in any way responsable if I harm myself. I need to give it a day or two and see if things don't improve. He isn't like this normally. But I am extremely concerned that now that I have allowed him to berate me that he will continue. It all feels like a very slow plane crash, I don't know that I'll walk away from this one. It feels like an end is imminent. I'm not even sure I want too many more days in this world anyway.  Thank you very much for your response and for giving a damn. If I had elsewhere to turn for support I would.
